description: For a user-selected local file in Codex, with explicit permission: create a private, one-use upload URL valid for at most five minutes. PUT only that JPEG/PNG/WebP file as raw bytes, with its image Content-Type, no API/OAuth headers and no redirects. Do not print or share the URL. The PUT saves/resizes the image in the connected account library and selects its website photo/product slot; product images use cached description preparation. Preserve clientImportId and the returned assetId. Never retry an uncertain upload automatically. Preparing does not upload or generate.

clientImportId.description: Stable UUID for this user-approved import. Never replace after an uncertain upload.
